subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be exposed through a new public `AgentSession.steer` options shape, or rebased as internal queue/run metadata on top of the current queued transcript recorder contract?
rationale: Current main has a newer transcript recorder path on the same APIs, and the PR also changes plugin SDK public surface, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape without owner intent.

options.title: Rebase as internal queue metadata
options.body: Preserve current `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` behavior and thread provenance through the existing queue option path without adding public steer API unless it is required.

options.title: Approve public steer options API
options.body: Accept the additive `AgentSession.steer` options object as plugin-facing API and require compatibility tests around legacy image-array and new provenance callers.

options.title: Pause for broader provenance design
options.body: Hold this PR until the related spawned-subagent provenance work has a shared owner-approved contract.

recommendation.title: Rebase as internal queue metadata
recommendation.body: Preserve current `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` behavior and thread provenance through the existing queue option path without adding public steer API unless it is required.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice affects public API and current main ownership boundaries, and steipete appears in CODEOWNERS/recent adjacent session-runtime history.
